name: weekly-status-updates
description: Write the weekly project status update your stakeholder can act on from their phone. RAG status calls with justification, revised dates for slipping projects, draft checks.

interface.longDescription: Turns raw project notes into the weekly status update a stakeholder can read and act on from their phone, reporting progress instead of effort. Makes the green, yellow, or red call with its justification, checks dependencies, and attaches the revised date a slipping project commits to. Before you send, the Draft Check returns a verdict on whether the update is ready. Built from the Weekly Status Updates playbook at andrewluxem.com. Static skill: no network calls.
capabilities: Weekly status updates from raw project notes
Green, yellow, red status calls with justification and revised dates
Draft checks with a ready-to-send verdict
defaultPrompt: Turn my project notes into a weekly status update
Is this project green or yellow?
Is this status update ready to send?
